whyNoMove: Every obsolete copy is already refused by the host (128 of 128 probes 403) and pinned by path and hash in the R01 relay release gate; moving one makes the gate fail closed on every later backend deploy, and the gate's governance forbids editing its manifest to regain a green release. Exposure is already 0, so a move buys no exposure reduction.

One dated alias of the full relay is registered by the R01 gate as an active full relay, passes the whole-source guard and answers 200. Its known consumer, a dated PWA alias, was archived by R3, but no evidence proves it has no other caller. By the ruling it stays in place and stops only on itself (DECISION-SHEET-05, item S5-2).

finding.summary: R3 moved 5 files that the R01 relay release gate pins in place (3 preserved_html, 2 preserved_backup). Their archived bytes equal the pins 5/5, but the gate requires them at their original location, so its verify step now fails closed. deploy.sh runs that step before upload, so every backend deploy stops before any change until reconciled. The R3 pre-move checks did not consult this gate; that omission is the defect.
